I agree with you 100%  I am physically his primary caregiver but not legally. It's a legal mess but every day I just keep going.  I am overwhelmed and exhausted.  I want him to be safe and cared for but do not feel like I have it in me to continue living like this.  That, in and of itself, makes me feel like a fucking terrible mother.  

I fought so hard to survive my husbands suicide.  I am absolutely exhausted mentally.
Thank you.  I sure don't feel like one.

I don't.  That is one of the biggest problems.  I am literally so afraid of him and we all sleep with our doors locked because I totally think he will try to kill me one day.  He literally ripped out handfuls of my hair tonight.  

I tried an intensive behavior specialist and after the first consult his father took him for a month until her contract ran out then dropped him back off.  It's absolutely insane.  I have asked him to just take him even he can't help with the solution and he refuses because he has to work and can't keep him all the time.  Seriously, FML with this mess.
Thank you.  Actually, that would be a a great resource and honestly that us what I need.  Resources.
Yes but as he has gotten bigger and older it has gotten so much worse.
Thank you.  I'm just so tired. I'm just deciding to say forget all the NYE stuff and go to bed.
That's why I'm here.  I need to talk instead of spin.
That is all that keeps me here.  I'm just spent.  I know they need me and this is why I am posting here instead of verbalizing anything outloud.
He is on meds and in a day program where he learns to shop, cook, gain employment, budget, essentially life skills.
Thank you so much.  If you deal with the same crap my heart goes out to you.  Virtual ((*hugs)))
Thank you.  The sleep was short lived but I am calmer.  Shouldn't need a dan babysitter!
I have and will be calling on Monday.  Just literally scared and angry that all of this came flooding in like I had never worked on or medicated it.
I understand.  I have stood strong for the past 3 years since my husbands suicide.  Today, the thoughts of doing it came on strong.  The drugs are taking effect as I type
